description: This file defines constants, enums, and structures for the VCNL4040 sensor driver, including register addresses, configuration options, and function prototypes for sensor interaction.

methods.name: vcnl4040_read
methods.description: Reads data from the specified register of the VCNL4040 sensor.

methods.name: vcnl4040_write
methods.description: Writes data to the specified register of the VCNL4040 sensor.

methods.name: vcnl4040_trigger_init
methods.description: Initializes trigger functionality for the sensor (if enabled).

methods.name: vcnl4040_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes for the VCNL4040.
